chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hannan, who said:

I was with Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) at the food-spread, so he inclined upon the vegetables, and I abstained from them due to an illness that was with me. So he turned towards me and said, 'O Hannan! Do you not know that Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) was never brought a platter except that upon it were vegetables?' I said, 'And why, may I be sacrificed for you?' So he said: 'Because the hearts of the believers are green, and they yearn for their forms.'

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful (Ali ibn Abi Talib)

ai.seo_question: Why did the Imams emphasize eating vegetables according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) illustrates the ascetic virtue (zuhd) of the Ahl al-Bayt by noting that Imam Ali (peace be upon him) consistently consumed vegetables, linking this dietary simplicity to the spiritual freshness of believers' hearts. This narration, found in al-Kafi, emphasizes that the 'greenness' of the heart signifies purity and a natural affinity for humble, earthy sustenance, reinforcing the Shia tradition of valuing modesty in consumption as a reflection of inner spiritual vitality.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hannan who said,

‘I was with Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> upon the food-spread, so he<sup>asws</sup> inclined upon the vegetables and I abstained from it due to an illness which was with me. So he<sup>asws</sup> turned towards me and said, ‘O Hanaan! Do you not know that Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> was never brought a platter except that upon it were vegetables?’ I said, ‘And why, may I be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Because the hearts of the Believers are green, and it yearns for its forms’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Hanan who has said the following:

“Once I was with abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, on the table-spread of food and he (the Imam) ate fresh herbs but I abstained because of a certain illness. He (the Imam) turned to me and said, ‘O Hanan, did you not know that whenever a package of food was brought to ’Amir al-Mu’minin it neccessarily had herbs in it?’ I then asked, T pray to Allah to keep my soul in service for your cause, why did it have to be as such?’ He (the Imam) said, ‘It is because the hearts of the believers are fresh, green and they incline to what is similar to it.’”
